test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 1) Foundational Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: Which one of the following subjects fall within the jurisdiction of both High Court and Supreme Court?

options.text: Protection from the violation of the constitution

solution:
The correct answer is option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

1) Dispute among States

 
• Falls under Supreme Court’s original jurisdiction (Article 131).
 
• ❌ Not shared with High Courts.

2) Dispute between Centre and State

 
• Also under Supreme Court’s original jurisdiction (Article 131).
 
• ❌ Not with High Courts.

3) Protection of Fundamental Rights

 
• ✔️ Both High Courts and Supreme Court have jurisdiction.
 
• High Courts → Article 226 (wider: can issue writs not only for FRs but also for other legal rights).
 
• Supreme Court → Article 32 (directly for enforcement of FRs).

4) Protection from violation of the Constitution

 
• Broadly applies, but enforcement mainly lies with the Supreme Court (judicial review, Article 13, 131, 136, 143). High Courts can also apply judicial review but “violation of the Constitution” as a whole is primarily tested at SC.

✅ Correct Answer:

3) Protection of Fundamental Rights
